core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aasima corresponds to Arabic عاصمة, the feminine form related to عاصم (“defender/protector”); عاصمة also has the separate lexical meaning “capital city.”

core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The record's previous primary gloss “Capital city” conflicted with the explanation and translations, which gave “protector/guardian.” Arabic lexicography supports عاصم as “defender/protector,” while عاصمة is also used for “capital city.” Both senses are documented; neither alone proves the personal-name's regional usage or popularity.
